transcript: Furnace repair for Elena Rostova at 219 Birch Hill Road. Furnace was overheating because the blower motor seized up. Replaced with a three-quarter horsepower ECM blower motor from our van stock, that's two hundred eighty dollars. Also replaced the worn fan belt for twenty-five dollars. We initially wrote down a diagnostic fee... actually wait, scratch the diagnostic fee, company policy waives it when customer approves the repair. Labor was two and a quarter hours total.

expected.job_summary: Replaced furnace blower motor and fan belt
expected.notes: Diagnostic fee waived with approved repair.
